Subject: Discrepancy on Payment 2026-03-20 (Invoice INV-1209)

Hi Evelyn,

We received the settlement for 2026-03-20 and are seeing a mismatch between the bank feed remittance and the payment application on your portal for INV-1209. The bank feed line shows a gross receipt of $12,480.00 but in Redwood's ledger the payment applied is $11,910.00. The $570 difference looks like a tax/VAT withholding on our side — however our AP team coded it to local VAT GL rather than a withheld tax clearing account, which is why it did not map cleanly to your AR application.

I've attached the bank feed export for the batch (bankfeed_export_20260321.csv) and the settlement statement. Can you confirm how Redwood prefers we send these withholdings so they match your AR posting? If you need us to reissue a manual remittance or provide a revised payment, we can do that — but ideally we avoid duplicate payments.

Thanks,
Sara Kim

Sara — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the files.

Quick summary from our side: the $570 was posted to a VAT receivable GL in your remittance file, which our automatic matcher treated as a partial payment + unmapped tax line. That left INV-1209 showing partially paid. To resolve without creating a duplicate cash event, we typically either (1) have the customer tag the withholding as "Withholding Tax - Remitted" and provide the withholding voucher so we can record a contra receivable, or (2) our finance team posts a journal that moves the VAT GL to the withheld-tax clearing account and applies the remainder to the invoice.

I tagged Marcus and Laura to propose the short journal path and confirm the exact GLs. Marcus — can you draft the JV we should post (date 2026-03-25) so we can both (a) clear the unapplied VAT line and (b) apply the cash to INV-1209? Laura — if this looks okay from an audit/recognition perspective, please sign off and I'll request Sara confirm the withholding voucher so Infranet and Redwood both have the audit trail.

Evelyn Hart
Finance Manager — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Evelyn / Laura / Sara —

Attached is a draft journal adjustment (journal_adjustment_03125.xlsx) that I recommend posting on 2026-03-25 to align ledger mapping to your bank feed. High level:

- Debit: Cash clearing / unapplied receipts .................. $12,480.00
- Credit: Revenue AR (INV-1209) .............................. $11,910.00
- Credit: Withholding tax clearing (GL 2302) .................. $570.00

To be explicit: the bank deposit already hit cash; our matcher split it between the invoice payment and a separate tax line. The JV moves the previously-mapped VAT entry from VAT receivable (incorrect) into the withheld tax clearing GL so the invoice shows fully paid and we have a proper clearing account for the tax. Journal narrative: "Reclassify bankfeed tax line for Infranet settlement 2026-03-20; apply cash to INV-1209."

Audit notes: this maintains revenue recognition as originally invoiced; there is no change to recognized revenue because the tax amount was never part of recognized revenue on our books. Laura — please confirm GL 2302 is acceptable and whether you prefer a supporting doc ID in the journal narrative (I can link the AP voucher if Sara shares it).

Sara — if you can send the withholding voucher or confirm the tax type + local remittance reference, we'll include that in the journal narrative so your AP and our accounting have the same reference.

Marcus Lin
